✓ 147th Anti-Aircraft Missile Regiment.question: The brigade was re-equipped with the S-300V SAM system between 1988 and 1990, the third _____ unit to receive the new weaponry and the first to go on combat alert with it
✓ 147th Anti-Aircraft Missile Regiment.fact: The brigade was re-equipped with the S-300V SAM system between 1988 and 1990, the third Soviet unit to receive the new weaponry and the first to go on combat alert with it. After the collapse of the Soviet Union the brigade became part of the Belarusian Air Defense Force, which merged into the air force in 2001.
